Dance of Knives Rogue Endgame Build Guide for Diablo IV Season 15 - Hell's Legacy

by Avarilyn
Season 15 - Hell's LegacyLast Updated: October 6, 2026
Endgame

Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

Introduction

Do you like moving at the pace of the Flash? Do you enjoy hitting the entire screen while spinning like a rampaging ballerina? Then the Dance of Knives Rogue is for you! This fast-paced spin-to-win build revolves around throwing daggers all over your screen, dealing devastating damage to all your foes.


Dance of Knives is an imbuement powerhouse that utilizes powerful synergies between Poison Imbuement and Damage over Time multipliers like Writhing Aspect and generic multipliers like Aspect of Channeling. The imbuement damage is further improved by using the Berú of Spellbound Steel Set bonus to gain access to all imbuements at increased potency! This allows you to gain access to Cold Imbuement and the powerful barrier generated by Buffered Battery.


Dance of Knives is a well-rounded build that allows you to swap freely between being a melee or ranged powerhouse, depending on whether you want to deal insane boss damage with Fan of Knives, or have long range and AoE coverage with Star Shards. Let's dive in to see how it works!

Equipment

Here you learn how to optimize your Dance of Knives Endgame Rogue with the correct Legendary and Unique items, Talisman and Charm options, Item Stat Priorities, Runes, and Class Mechanic choices.

Stats

  • There are no breakpoints! Just stack Damage over Time increases, Poison Damage, and Vulnerable Damage Multipliers where possible.
  • The stats are Masterworked according to what provides the highest relative damage increase when comparing all the new multipliers.


Equipment

  • Rush towards the Berú of Spellbound Steel set as soon as possible, as this allows you to get various synergies like Vulnerable, Weaken, Buffered Battery etc.

Stats

  • There are no breakpoints! Just stack Damage over Time increases, Poison Damage, and Vulnerable Damage Multipliers where possible.
  • The stats are Masterworked according to what provides the highest relative damage increase when comparing all the new multipliers.
  • You want to have balanced ranks in Dance of Knives: Star Shards and Poison Imbuement, meaning they should be as equal as possible without losing total ranks. So it is always worth picking a +3 ranks Charm over a +2 ranks Charm, but you should aim for them to be as equal as possible.


Equipment

  • Etna's Lost Dagger is activated from dealing Poison Damage and the different imbuements from Berú of Spellbound Steel.
  • Shrouded Gift is triggered by alternating Smoke Grenade: Silhouetteand Concealment.
    • If you do not enjoy this playstyle, swap this for an item for Snowveiled Aspect or Aspect of Disobedience.
  • Asheara's Khanjar increases your attack speed and damage, both of which increase your damage dealt with Poison Imbuement.
  • Stone of Jordan increases all your resistances based on the Highest Resistance you have. Because of this, make sure to get Poison resistance on your gear and charms.
  • Cowl of the Nameless not only provides us with solid damage, but it also applies Cold Imbuement and Shadow Imbuement on AoE.
    • This means we apply both Vulnerable and Weaken on all targets constantly.


Charms

  • Rush towards the Berú of Spellbound Steel set as soon as possible, as this unlocks various synergies and effects like Vulnerable, Weaken, Buffered Battery etc.
  • Sea Lord's Fine Gloves is currently bugged and works even with Dance of Knives: Star Shards.


Runes

  • Bac+Que provides a massive barrier, which is further empowered by Barrier Generation affixes on your gear.
  • Neo+Lac provides a substantial amount of damage reduction.

Stats

  • There are no breakpoints! Just stack Damage over Time increases, Poison Damage, and Vulnerable Damage Multipliers where possible.
  • The stats are Masterworked according to what provides the highest relative damage increase when comparing all the new multipliers.
  • You want to have balanced ranks in Dance of Knives: Star Shards and Poison Imbuement, meaning they should be as equal as possible without losing total ranks. So it is always worth picking a +3 ranks Charm over a +2 ranks Charm, but you should aim for them to be as equal as possible.


Equipment

  • Etna's Lost Dagger is activated from dealing Poison Damage and the different imbuements from Berú of Spellbound Steel.
  • Shrouded Gift is triggered by alternating Smoke Grenade: Silhouette and Concealment.
    • If you do not enjoy this playstyle, swap this for an item with Aspect of Debilitating Toxins or Aspect of Disobedience.
  • Stone of Jordan increases all your resistances based on the Highest Resistance you have. Because of this, make sure to get Poison resistance on your gear and charms.
  • Cowl of the Nameless not only provides us with solid damage, but it also applies Cold Imbuement and Shadow Imbuement on AoE.
    • This means we apply both Vulnerable and Weaken on all targets constantly.
  • Enigma provides a lot of great stats, like Ranks to All Skills, Damage Reduction, and importantly Movement Speed. Abyssal Splinter of Pain was changed to x70% movement speed (reduction of 30% multiplicatively), meaning we need more Movement Speed than before to remain capped.
    • Do not overuse Teleport given by Enigma in this build. It eats your resources in this build. Due to this, we run Dark Shroud: Overflow instead of Dark Shroud: Shadow Dancer.
    • If you do not enjoy this, you can swap to a normal Legendary chest with Aspect of Debilitating Toxins or Aspect of Disobedience.
    • Despite swapping to your Ranged weapon, it does not break Duelist's Aspect nor trigger Earthstriker's Aspect.
  • The difference between Grief and Asheara's Khanjar is very small when not factoring in the Poisoning effect on Grief (as its scaling is currently untested). You can use either, but Grief has a very small edge.


Charms

Seal of the Diamond Mind allows you to pick up both Phoba of Spellbound Steel and Phoba of the Sightless. If you do not have one yet, use the Charm setup from the Midgame variant and swap Smoke Grenade: Silhouette for Dash: Primer if you want more mobility.

  • The Berú of Spellbound Steel set gives you access to various synergies like Vulnerable, Weaken, Buffered Battery, extra Lucky Hit Chance etc.
    • After the 2 Set bonus was buffed in Season 15, Inner Sight has been replaced by Preparation.
  • The Phoba of the Sightless set gives you ultimate skill reset whenever you break Stealth, damage reduction after casting Concealment, as well as a damage boost.
  • You want to use a Hellfire Torch, make sure that it matches the set you are replacing though.


Runes

  • Bac +Que provides a massive barrier, which is further empowered by Barrier Generation affixes on your gear.
  • Yax + Vex gives skill ranks to both Dance of Knives and Poison Imbuement, giving you a large damage bonus.
  • IF you run the Diablo Boss Power, you can run Mal + Lo for a consistent powerful buff, which is about 4% more damage than Yax + Vex.


Alternatives:

  • Ner activates Concealment, which gives you higher uptime on Unstoppable and Shrouded Gift.
  • Lac boosts your defenses, giving you 20% Damage Reduction.


Transfigures

  • Amulet: Exploiter's Aspect, Earthstriker's Aspect, and Aspect of Mending Obscurity
  • Jewelry: Ranks to All Skills, Poison % Damage
  • Rest: Poison % Damage


Soul Splinters

Soul Splinters are special gems for Season 15. Prioritize equipping them in your jewelry in the order below:

  1. Abyssal Splinter of Hellfire
  2. Abyssal Splinter of Pain
  3. Abyssal Splinter of the Black Soulstone


Mythic Priority Order

Work through this list as you find the recommended Mythics for the build. Note: You can only equip one Mythic that you craft in the Horadric Cube.

  1. Etna's Lost Dagger
  2. Cowl of the Nameless
  3. Stone of Jordan
  4. Shrouded Gift


Upgrading Grief and Enigma is not currently worth it.

DISCLAIMER: This build is made ONLY for BOSSING. Do not play this in other content, as it basically just one-shots every boss in the game.

Stats

  • The stats are Masterworked according to what provides the highest relative damage increase when comparing all the new multipliers.


Equipment

  • You use the Berú of the Sightless set to get access to Clone, and to reset your Concealment rapidly through Sentry spam.
  • Crown of Lucion is a massive damage multiplier, and is enabled through us spamming Concealment and getting the energy back from Tibault's Will.
  • Sea Lord's Fine Gloves is very good for this, as it increases your Maximum energy for Crown of Lucion leeway and damage.
  • Etna's Lost Dagger is activated from dealing Poison Damage with Poison Imbuement and a Lucky Hit: Shadow Damage on Rustbitten Dirk.
  • Fist of the Iron Rose is activated from Sentry
  • Aspect of Mending Obscurity on our boots gives us the Fortify needed for Crushing Aspect.
  • Calculation gives us the Overpower needed for Earthstriker's Aspect


Runes

  • Bac+Que provides a massive barrier, which is further empowered by Barrier Generation affixes on your gear.
  • Zan+Vex sustains our 3 stacks of Vex easily as we spam Sentry constantly while spinning.

DISCLAIMER: This build is made for Pushing. If you want a better farming experience, use the Endgame variant.

Stats

  • There are no breakpoints! Just stack Damage over Time increases, Poison Damage, and Vulnerable Damage Multipliers where possible.
  • The stats are Masterworked according to what provides the highest relative damage increase when comparing all the new multipliers.
  • Imbuement Potency tempers are better when you play with Phoba of the Sightless.


Equipment

  • You use the Berú of the Sightless set to get access to Clone, and to reset your Concealment rapidly through Sentry spam.
  • Etna's Lost Dagger is activated from dealing Poison Damage with Poison Imbuement and the Lightning Damage fromKry or Teleport
  • Fist of the Iron Rose is activated from Sentry
  • Aspect of Mending Obscurity provides much-needed sustain to stay alive.
  • Concealment: Calculation gives us the Overpower needed for Earthstriker's Aspect
  • Stone of Jordan provides a lot of defenses, which is great due to us taking more damage from Abyssal Splinter of the Black Soulstone.
  • Blood-Mad Idol provides an insane damage multiplier, at the cost of needing extra healing. This is where Aspect of Mending Obscurity shines, as spamming Shadow Clone: Sentry, Concealment, and Smoke Grenade: Silhouette causes us to enter stealth, healing us constantly.
  • Infinity has a baseline that is almost equal to a fully ramped Writhing Aspect, while providing us Crushing Blow, which deals 5% of current HP until the boss reaches 30%. This is a must-use for pushing high Pit and Tower.
  • We use Enigma to maintain Earthstriker's Aspect in combat, as Teleport forces you to swap to your Ranged weapon briefly.
  • Leoric's Crown is higher boss damage and roughly equal AoE, making it a slightly better choice especially with Gem Strength transfigure.
    • You can use Cowl of the Nameless, but it is slightly less boss damage.


Runes

  • Mal+ Lo gives us Deadly Strike, which causes our DoTs to have a chance to deal double damage.
  • Zan+ Kry groups enemies on cooldown as we spam Sentry constantly while spinning.

Skills

Learn more about the Skill Tree and Gameplay Rotation for the Dance of Knives Endgame Rogue here.

  • Use Shadow Clone to gain Ferocity and to double your damage output.
    • Try to make sure you have Shadow Clone available against dangerous enemies like bosses.
  • Activate your Poison Imbuement as you are about to start spinning with Dance of Knives
  • Hold down Dance of Knives to Spin to Win!
  • If you need Unstoppable, use Shadow Step on an enemy.
  • If you need to reposition or traverse the map, use Dash.

The rotation for Dance of Knives is quite simple! Follow the priority list below:

  • Cast Dark Shroud immediately.
  • Cast Shadow Clone immediately.
  • Cast and hold down your Dance of Knives.
  • While spinning, cast Poison Imbuement.
  • Rotate between Dash: Primer and Concealment to gain the Damage Reduction from Shrouded Gift


Automatic:

  • Shadow Imbuement and Cold Imbuement with all of their upgrades (marked with Blue outline in the Skill Tree) are passively activated when you trigger Inner Sight.

The rotation for Dance of Knives is quite simple! Follow the priority list below:

  • Cast Dark Shroud immediately.
    • The uptime on this is important, as it sustains your energy spent from Enigma Teleport through Dark Shroud: Overflow.
  • Cast Shadow Clone immediately.
  • Cast and hold down your Dance of Knives.
  • While spinning, cast Poison Imbuement.
  • Rotate between Smoke Grenade: Silhouette and Concealment to gain the Damage Buff and Damage Reduction from Berú of the Sightless, and the Damage Reduction from Shrouded Gift
    • You can play Dash: Primer instead of Smoke Grenade: Silhouette, at the cost of Shadow Clone uptime.

Automatic:

  • Shadow Imbuement and Cold Imbuement with all of their upgrades (marked with Blue outline in the Skill Tree) are passively activated when you trigger Inner Sight.

The rotation for Dance of Knives is quite simple! Follow the priority list below:

  • Cast Dark Shroud immediately.
  • Drop a Smoke Grenade: Silhouette on your feet to reset your Sentry through Berú of the Sightless.
  • Cast Concealment for Unstoppable
  • Cast Sentry to apply Vulnerable and Weaken, and activate Fist of the Iron Rose.
  • Cast and hold down your Dance of Knives.
  • While spinning, cast Poison Imbuement.
  • Spam Sentry and Concealment to sustain your energy, apply Vulnerable and Weaken, and maintainFist of the Iron Rose.

Paragon

Progress your Dance of Knives Endgame Rogue through the Pit to rank up your Glyphs. Carefully check your Paragon Boards to ensure correct order and rotation.

The Legendary Node Rush setup is optional, but it provides the most power early on as Glyphs are nowhere near as important as the Legendary nodes.





Learn more details about this system and how to unlock all points in our in-depth Paragon Guide and Season Rank Guide.

Mercenary

Mercenaries are unlocked during the Vessel of Hatred campaign and assist you in battle. You can have one hired (permanent) mercenary during solo play and a reinforcement who assists you from time to time in certain situations. Here are our recommendations for the Dance of Knives Endgame Rogue.

Hired: Raheir

Due to the defensive requirement in higher Torment levels, we pick up Raheir as our hired Mercenary to provide us with powerful defensive buffs, such as Valiance, Raheir's Aegis, and Bastion.


Reinforcement: Aldkin

Aldkin provides us with a powerful defensive buff in the form of Field of Languish.

FAQ & Mechanics

Take a look at this section for a deeper dive on Frequently Asked Questions, common mistakes and the underlying mechanics of how the Dance of Knives Endgame Rogue works.

  • Endgame Variant:

    Vulnerable: Shadow Imbuement: Vulnerable

    Weaken: Cold Imbuement

    Resolve: Cold Imbuement: Resolve

    Ferocity: Concealment: Ferocity and Shadow Clone: Relentless

    Unstoppable: Concealment: Unstoppable

    Overpower: Cold Imbuement: Overpower

    Fortify: Concealment: Recuperate

  • As of Patch 3.2.1, Imbuement Potency is bugged in new ways.

    • Etna's Lost Dagger, Efficacy, and Aspect of Corruption now works for Shadow Clone.
    • Phoba of Spellbound Steel and Imbuement Potency tempers are still in the same cap, and does not work for Shadow Clone.
    • If you cast Shadow Clone while you have Etna's Lost Dagger active, it does not benefit from the Potency buff from Etna's Lost Dagger.
    • Poison Imbuement: Toxic Touch does not work for Shadow Clone.


    Because of these bugs, the current rule is simple:

    • If you run Phoba of Spellbound Steel, you temper Damage over Time on your gear.
    • If you run Phoba of the Sightless, you temper Imbuement Potency.


    You can do the math for this if you desire, but it is obscure and involves a lot of bugs.

  • The math on whether or not Leoric's Crown is better is a bit weird.

    • Slotting in Abyssal Splinter of Hellfire in your helmet instead of ring is a 22% damage increase (1.83 / 1.5 = 1.22)
    • Slotting in Abyssal Splinter of the Black Soulstone in your Leoric's Crown is a ~21.3% damage increase at 20 stacks (1.82 / 1.5 = 1.2133
    • Combined means a 1.22 x 1.213 = 1.48 = 48% damage increase


    This means Leoric's Crown is about a 48% damage increase over not running it for the Pit/Tower where you have enemies to kill for Abyssal Splinter of the Black Soulstone. But what is the value of Cowl of the Nameless?

    • You get AoE Vulnerable through Shadow Imbuement: Vulnerable.
    • You get AoE Weaken through Cold Imbuement.
    • You get AoE damage through Poison Imbuement.


    On Bossing, Leoric's Crown wins compared to Cowl of the Nameless as the added AoE benefit does not matter. But due to how Dance of Knives: Star Shards works and the limited mass AoE it has, Cowl of the Nameless does a lot of heavy lifting. But for the bossing variant, Crown of Lucion is significantly more damage than the Leoric's Crown setup. For now, use Cowl of the Nameless for any AoE scenario, and Leoric's Crown for bossing until you have the full bossing variant.

Summary

The Spin-to-Win is back with a Vengeance in Lord of Hatred, dealing devastating damage to any foe foolish enough to challenge you.

  • Berú of Spellbound Steel allows you to fully embrace the Imbuement Rogue fantasy by giving you all three imbuements and their synergies.
  • Play Star Shards if you want to play a range variant of this build, or Fan of Knives if you want to destroy bosses.
  • Endgame is dangerous, so make sure to bolster your defenses as much as you can while you progress through the Torment levels.

Changelog

  • Added Enigma and Leoric's Crown to push variant

    • Enigma allows for Earthstriker's Aspect to generate Overpower on bosses.
    • Leoric's Crown is slightly more damage on bosses without Gem Strength, and the go to if you get a Gem Strength transfigure.
      • Cowl of the Nameless is still viable, just less boss damage.

    • Changed Duelist's Aspect for Neurotoxic Aspect after seeing that Enigma Teleport force weapon swaps and it breaks the stacks.

  • Significant update to the Push variant after doing Tower 135 without Transfiguration.

    • Added Blood-Mad Idol
    • Added Infinity
    • Changed Rune Setup
    • Swapped Concealment: Recuperate to Concealment: Calculation
    • Added Grief

    Bossing:

    • Added Infinity
